title: Ensure any change to code receives approval of two strongly authenticated users
description: Requiring two approvals means no single account — compromised, careless, or malicious — can land code on its own. One approver is a rubber stamp waiting to happen; two makes collusion or a single stolen credential insufficient.
remediation: Repository settings -> Pull requests -> Merge checks: enable "Minimum approvals" and set it to at least 2. To cover every repository at once, set the same check at Project settings -> Pull requests -> Merge checks, which repositories inherit unless they override it.
fixSummary: Set "Minimum approvals" to at least 2 at Repository settings -> Pull requests -> Merge checks.
